title: Wave 4 partner performance harness environment, fixtures, break-list fields and gate are not specified
source: Recovery Workbench Data Migration Stories v3, RWB-DM-008; FSD P1 v3; Template and Rules v1 §R5.5
description: No source names the harness environment and base hosts, the synthetic cutover extract fixture and its field layout, the break-list fields, the extract format and retention, or the pass or fail gate and its seeding set for the partner performance cutover reconciliation.
evidence: RWB-DM-008 states only that the migration breaks are listed on the reconciliation extract and gives no layout; the legacy story, the Arch v5 extract and the Temporal and Drools extract carry no environment, fixture, retention or gate value.
proposed: Agree at the wave entry check: the SIT environment and base hosts, one synthetic cutover extract per business date, break-list fields of firm, key type, key value, reason and the two owners, a file extract retained with the wave record, and one binary gate.
